name: 3D Glass Solutions
capabilities: Advanced glass substrates for semiconductor packaging
Glass interposer for HPC/AI and photonics
summary: 3D Glass Solutions specializes in manufacturing advanced glass substrates for semiconductor packaging, addressing thermal, electrical, and dimensional challenges in RF, HPC, and photonic systems. Their solutions include 3D heterogeneous integration and glass interposers, supporting applications in RF subsystems, aerospace, defense, and photonics.
